dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: im feeling a little down yaar

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: supporter

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Nahi, it is completely on me aur sab kuch mujhe hi handle karna pad raha hai.
dialog.content_en: no its all on me

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I think ki tumhe ek advocate arrange karne ke baare mein dekhna chahiye. You have a legal right representation ka.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: holidays ki vajah se abhi koi fayda nahi hoga

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ah I do understand yaar. Main bhi frustrate ho jata hoon jab year ke is time par sab things grind to a halt ho jati hain. Kya tum appeal time ke liye extension ask kar sakte ho?

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: par thank you tumhare suggestions ke liye
dialog.content_en: but thank you for your suggestions

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Yeh bohot harsh sound karta hai, especially current situation ko dekhte hue. Main suggest karunga ki tum legally check karo kahan stand karte ho kyunki mujhe sure hai ki yeh right nahi ho sakta.
dialog.content_en: That sounds very harsh, especially given the current situation. I suggest that you find out where you stand legally because I am sure that this can't be right

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: yes i believe so, main abhi future career goals ke liye alternatives dekh raha hoon
dialog.content_en: Yes i believe so, i am currently looking into alternatives as far as future career goals

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main samajh sakta hoon ki tum bohot hopeless aur anxious feel kar rahe ho right now. Kya is season ke liye koi fun plans hain tumhare?
dialog.content_en: I can tell you are feeling really hopeless and anxious right now. Do you have any fun plans for the season?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: i am feeling both honestly, plans toh hain mere paas par jaane ka bilkul mann nahi hai
dialog.content_en: i am feeling both honestly i do have plans but do not want to go

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I think yeh ek good idea hoga ki tum khud ko thoda coax karke jaane ki try karo. Jab wahan reach karoge toh you will probably enjoy it :)
dialog.content_en: I think it would be a good idea to try to coax yourself into going. You will probably enjoy it when you get there :)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main kuch trips par gaya tha family ko visit karne, I did not really enjoy myself, main bas alone rehna chahta hoon.
dialog.content_en: i have been to a few trips visiting family i did not really enjoy myself i want to be alone

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: yahi meri current problem hai
dialog.content_en: that is my current problem

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I think that main depressed hoon.
dialog.content_en: i think i am depressed

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya tumne doctor se speak karne ka socha hai? Maybe tumhe kuch medication ya counselling se benefit mil jaye.
dialog.content_en: Have you considered speaking to your doctor? You might benefit from some medication or counselling.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: main already medication par hoon, mujhe severe depression ki problem hai
dialog.content_en: i am currently on medication i suffer from severe depression

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am sorry yaar. Mujhe bhi depression hai aur main bhi meds par hoon toh I can totally understand your pain.
dialog.content_en: I am sorry. I suffer from depression also and am on medication so I can understand your pain.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: thank you
dialog.content_en: Thank you

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: yeh bohot hard hai
dialog.content_en: its very hard

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Unfortunately current global situation hum kisi ki bhi help nahi kar rahi. Hamesha darte rehna bohot terrible feel hota hai.
dialog.content_en: Unfortunately the current global situation is not helping any of us. It is terrible to feel scared all the  time.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: this is true
dialog.content_en: This is true

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you, mujhe thoda better feel ho raha hai yeh know karke ki I am not the only one going through this.
dialog.content_en: thank you I feel a little better knowing im not the only one going through this

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Perhaps tum ek list make kar sakte ho un things ki jo New Year mein karni hain taaki focus karne ke liye kuch ho tumhare paas?
dialog.content_en: Perhaps you could make a list of things that you mean to do in the New Year to give you something to focus on?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh actually ek bohot good idea hai.
dialog.content_en: thats a good idea actually

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I used to have a journal par years se usme kuch write nahi kiya.
dialog.content_en: I use to have a journal but havent wrote in it for years

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: woh bohot help karta tha
dialog.content_en: it helped a lot

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Make sure ki sirf realistic goals hi choose karo taaki despondent feel na ho aur agar kuch work out na ho toh khud par bohot harsh mat hona!
dialog.content_en: Make sure to only choose realistic goals so's not to make yourself feel despondent and do not be too hard on yourself if something does not work out!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Journal likhna ek fantastic idea hai. Tum time ke sath apna personal progress track kar paoge.
dialog.content_en: A journal is a fantastic idea. You can track your personal progress over a period of time.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: thank you tum sahi bol rahe ho, main khud par bohot pressure daal leta hoon
dialog.content_en: Thank you youre right i put too much on myself

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Unfortunately depression ki vajah se we tend to judge ourselves bohot harshly. Main bhi past mein iska victim raha hoon.
dialog.content_en: Unfortunately, depression does mean that we can judge ourselves far too harshly. I have been guilty of that myself in the past.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes yeh mujhe years se bother kar raha hai aur it is like a weight on my shoulders.
dialog.content_en: Yes it has bothered me for years and its like a weight on my shoulders

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I hope ki main tumhare liye thoda comfort ban paya hoon aur kuch sochne ke liye de paya hoon. Have a lovely Christmas!
dialog.content_en: I hope I have been able to be of some comfort to you and given you something to think about. Have a lovely Christmas!

dialog.speaker: seeker

dialog.content_en: you too and thank you again

dialog.speaker: supporter

situation: Going to the store gives me Panic Attacks, driving does as well.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Store me jaane se mujhe panic attacks aate hain! Driving karte waqt bhi mujhe bahut high anxiety feel hoti hai.
dialog.content_en: Going to the store gives me Panic Attacks! Driving also makes me highly anxious.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main medication par hoon but isse sirf moderately hi help mil rahi hai.
dialog.content_en: I am on medication but this only seems to help moderately.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello
dialog.content_en: Hello

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hi
dialog.content_en: Hi

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Toh bas ye ensure karne ke liye ki I understand you correctly, aapko pandemic ke time store jaane me anxiety feel ho rahi hai?
dialog.content_en: So just to ensure that I understand you correctly, you are feeling anxious about going to the store during the pandemic

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: No. Yeh toh pandemic se pehle se start hua tha.
dialog.content_en: No. This has been going on before the pandemic

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: COVID ki wajah se my anxiety didn't happen.
dialog.content_en: COVID didn't cause my anxiety

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Achha, toh matlab isko lekar it's just general anxiety then.
dialog.content_en: Okay, so just general anxiety about it then.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yessir
dialog.content_en: Yessir

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aapko ye anxiety ka issue kab se hai?
dialog.content_en: How long have you had this anxiety issue?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Bas pichle kuch saalon se. Ek nail salon me achanak shuru hua tha jab mujhe acrylic nails ke chemical se allergic reaction ho gaya tha.
dialog.content_en: Only the past couple of years. It came on suddenly at a nail salon after I had an allergic reaction to a chemical in acrylic nails.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Starting me doctors ko laga tha ki yeh brain inflammation hai.
dialog.content_en: Originally the doctors thought it was brain inflammation.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Isse improve karne ke liye what suggestions do you have?
dialog.content_en: What suggestions do you have for improving it?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Meditation?
dialog.content_en: Meditation?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Exercise?
dialog.content_en: Exercise?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main art karti hoon. And jab main painting kar rahi hoti hoon tab I never get anxiety, par I cannot exactly do that at the store.
dialog.content_en: I do art. And never have anxiety when I'm painting, however, I cannot exactly do that at the store

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya aapne aise support groups look for karne ka socha hai jo public me anxiety face karte hain?
dialog.content_en: Have you thought about looking for support groups with people who also have anxiety about being in public?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I have thought about it and try bhi kiya hai.
dialog.content_en: I have and I did

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya aapne store me apne sath kisi friend ko lane ka socha hai? Someone you are comfortable with? Jiske sath aap comfortable ho use rakhne se bahar jaate waqt anxiety calm karne me help mil sakti hai.
dialog.content_en: Have you thought about brining a friend with you to the store? Someone you are comfortable with? Having someone you are comfortable with may help to calm the anxiety while you are out.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Support groups se panic attacks rokne me waise koi खास help nahi milti. Unse alag alag tarah ki sensations hone lagti hain. Fast heart rate, chills, shakes, mera brain foggy aur impersonal feel karne lagta hai.
dialog.content_en: Support groups don't really help stop the Panic Attacks. They cause all sorts of sensations. Fast heart rate, chills, shakes, My brain feels foggy and impersonal.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main apne fiance ke sath often store visit karti hoon :)
dialog.content_en: I do go to the store often with my fiance :)

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Usse kaafi help mili hai
dialog.content_en: That has helped a lot

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe bhi past me public places me anxiety hoti thi, isliye I know what it feels like to be anxious while out.
dialog.content_en: I have also had anxiety in the past when in public places, so I know how it feels to be anxious while out.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Haan, yeh definitely annoying hai. But it's not JUST at the store. Mujhe Panic Attack Disorder diagnose hua hai and ghar par bhi attacks aate hain jahan I freak out.
dialog.content_en: Yeah, it's definitely annoying. But it isn't JUST at the store. I was diagnosed with Panic Attack Disorder and even have attacks at home where I freak out.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Jab se medication le rahi hoon tab se it's better, par I never feel completely normal.
dialog.content_en: It's been better since I was on medication but I never feel completely....normal

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ek aur cheez jo help kar sakti hai woh hai ki you can put some headphones in attached to your phone or MP3 player taaki you can listen to calming music while you are out.
dialog.content_en: Another thing that may help is having some headphones in attached to your phone or an MP3 player so you can have some calming music or something in your ear while you are out.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh actually me ek bahut good idea hai. Distractions definitely seem to be the best way to go for me.
dialog.content_en: That's actually a really good idea. Distractions definitely seem to be the way to go for me.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Shayad isiliye art helps so much.
dialog.content_en: That's probably why art helps so much

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Maine bhi notice kiya ki distractions mere liye bhi bahut great the!
dialog.content_en: I found that distractions were great for me too!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe samajh nahi aata ki calming music hona chahiye ya music that I generally feel like dancing to.
dialog.content_en: I wonder if it should be calming music or music that I generally feel like dancing too

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe pata hai ki sometimes calming music se I become more centered aur khud ko zyada aware feel karti hoon, jo kabhi kabhi problems ko exacerbate kar deta hai.
dialog.content_en: I know that sometimes calming music kinda makes me more centered and aware of myself which can exacerbate the problems sometimes.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main anxiety me help ke liye car me jab hoti hoon toh I usually listen to music loudly.
dialog.content_en: I usually listen to music loudly when Im in my car to help with the anxiety

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Of course, mujhe hamesha lagta hai ki it's working phir I reach the store aur my hands hurt from gripping my steering wheel so hard XD.
dialog.content_en: Of course, I always think its working then I get to the store and my hands hurt from gripping my steering wheel so hard XD

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Aapko jo bhi music best lage, wahi sunna would be a good idea.
dialog.content_en: Whatever music you think would be best would be a good idea.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mujhe lagta hai my anxiety doesn't stem from social stuff, balki fear of death se aati hai tbh.
dialog.content_en: I think a lot of my anxiety doesnt stem from social stuff but from a fear of death tbh

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Aap aur kaunse other distractions recommend kar sakte ho?
dialog.content_en: What other distractions can you reccomend?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: *recommend
dialog.content_en: *recommend

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Kya aapke paas koi stress ball ya aisi koi cheez hai jise you can keep with you in your pocket while out?
dialog.content_en: Do you have a stress ball or something you can keep with you in your pocket while out?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere paas nahi hai!
dialog.content_en: I don't!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Mujhe lagta hai ki picking up one of those and having it with you se bhi help mil sakti hai!
dialog.content_en: I think picking up one of those and having it with you might also help!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yeh bhi ek bahut accha idea hai. Thanks so much
dialog.content_en: That's a really good idea too. Thanks so much

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You're very welcome!
dialog.content_en: You're very welcome!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: <3 Have a good one!
dialog.content_en: <3 Have a good one!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Thank you, you too!
dialog.content_en: Thank you, you too!

seeker_question1: Nothing. It was honestly a bit helpful!

situation: My partner says that I have to move out. I have been trying to find a place to live, but it is difficult.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi yaar! Today aap kaisa feel kar rahe ho?
dialog.content_en: Hi! How are you feeling today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am feeling bahut frustrated. Main ek alternate place dhoond raha hoon rehne ke liye, but mujhe koi aisi affordable jagah nahi mil rahi jo mere work ke paas ho.
dialog.content_en: I am feeling frustrated. I have been looking for an alternate place to live, but I have not been able to find a place that I can afford that is close to my work.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Main janta hoon ki kabhi kabhi yeh really frustrating hota hai. I am pretty sure ki you will definitely able to find one soon.
dialog.content_en: I know sometime it's really frustrating. I am pretty sure you will definitely able to find one.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere partner ne bola hai ki agar maine move out nahi kiya, toh woh mere saare clothes aur belonging bahar phenk denge aur locks change kar denge. I am very upset about that.
dialog.content_en: My partner said that if I do not move out, they will put my clothes and belonging outside and change the locks. I am very upset about that.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: May I know your requirements for the place other than closer to work? Kya aap accommodation share karna chahenge?
dialog.content_en: May I know your requirements for the place other than closer to work? would you like to share the accommodation?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere paas mere clothes aur ek dresser ke alawa zyada kuch nahi hai. I would prefer to live alone, but roommate chalega.
dialog.content_en: i do not have much besides my clothes and a dresser. I would prefer to live alone, but I would consider a roommate.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am really sorry yeh sun kar. Your partner ko aapki situation samajhni chahiye.
dialog.content_en: I am really sorry to know about that. Your partner should understand your situation.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mera partner meri situation samajhta hai aur yeh bhi ki mere liye dusri jagah dhoondna kitna difficult hai, but they do not care at all.
dialog.content_en: My partner understands my situation and how difficult it is for me to find another place to live, but they do not care.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You should online search karna chahiye ya apne friends aur family se help mangni chahiye agar woh nearby rehte hain toh.
dialog.content_en: You should search online or ask your friends or family for help if you they live nearby.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mera koi friend nahi hai. Yeh mujhe tab pata chala jab maine partner ke sath break up karna start kiya. Jinko main friends manta tha, woh unke hi friends nikle.
dialog.content_en: I have no friends. I discovered this when I started to break up with my partner. What I called my friends have turned out to be their friends instead.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am from Texas and meri family wahi rehti hai.
dialog.content_en: i am from Texas and my family live there.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Ek acchi place dhoondna really hard hota hai. Time aur money kabhi kabhi big constraints ban jate hain but we should keep trying.
dialog.content_en: It is really hard to find a good place to live. Time and money are sometime the big constraints but we should keep trying.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere mom dad abhi alive nahi hain, bas ek sister hai.
dialog.content_en: I do not have a mother or father still living, just a sister.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere paas jagah dhoondne ke liye time bahut kam bacha hai, aur thode se paise hi saved hain. I do not think ki deposit ke liye enough honge.
dialog.content_en: I am running out of time to find a place to live, and I have a small amount of money saved up. I do not think that I have enough for a deposit.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: True friends milna hamesha hard hota hai. You must be a strong person and I know you can achieve anything.
dialog.content_en: It is always hard to find true friends. You must be a strong person and I know you can achieve anything.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Mere partner ne bola hai ki mere paas January 1 tak ka time hai uske baad woh locks change kar denge.
dialog.content_en: My partner said that I have until the January 1 before he will change the locks.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Believe in yourself and don't give up yaar. Definitely koi solution mil hi jayega.
dialog.content_en: Believe in yourself and don't give up. Definitely some solution will be around.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main restaurant industry mein as a waiter kaam karta tha and mujhe layoff kar diya gaya hai. October ke baad se maine koi job nahi ki.
dialog.content_en: I work in the restaurant industry as a waiter and I have been laid off. I have not worked since October.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Main ek large city mein rehta hoon aur rent bahut expensive hai. I feel very sad about this.
dialog.content_en: I live in a large city and rent is expensive. I feel sad about this.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am really sorry yeh sun kar. Main bhi laid off ho gaya tha aur worried tha, phir maine online work search karna start kiya. Mil gaya aur ab wahi kar raha hoon. Hope it will work for you too.
dialog.content_en: I am really sorry to hear about that. I also got laid off and was worried, then I start searching online work. Found it and doing it now. Hope it will work for you too.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Sometimes mujhe lagta nahi ki yeh meri effort ke worth hai. Bed se uthna bhi hard lagta hai. I tend to sleep bahut zyada.
dialog.content_en: Sometimes I do not feel like it is worth my effort. I have a hard time getting out of bed. I tend to sleep a lot.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Is tough time mein humein motivated rehna chahiye aur keep trying karna chahiye.
dialog.content_en: At this tough time we need to stay motivated and keep trying.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I appreciate your kind words yaar. Mujhe bahut lonely feel ho raha hai.
dialog.content_en: i appreciate your kind words. I feel very alone.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I really like talking to you, hope yeh aapko positive rehne mein help karega.
dialog.content_en: I really like talking to you, hope it will help you in staying positive.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Last weekend meri phone par sister se baat ho rahi thi and usne bola ki mujhe doctor ke paas visit karna chahiye.
dialog.content_en: I was speaking with my sister on the phone last weekend and she said that I should go to the doctor.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Unfortunately, mere paas insurance nahi hai. Maine call kiya tha and unhone bataya ki initial visit ke liye over $200 cost aayegi.
dialog.content_en: Unfortunately, I do not have insurance. I called and they said it would cost over $200 for an initial visit.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am not sure about my options right now yaar.
dialog.content_en: I am not sure about my options.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Doctor ki advice lene mein koi harm nahi hai. Sorry to hear about that yaar. Aap online counselling try kar sakte ho. Aisi bahut saari websites hain jo free counselling sessions offer karti hain. You can search on Google.
dialog.content_en: There is no harm in taking doctors advice. Sorry to here about that. you can try online counselling. there are so many website offering free counselling sessions. you can search on google

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Maine online counselling ke baare mein socha nahi tha, main toh bas somewhere else rehne ki jagah dhoondne mein busy tha. I will look online.
dialog.content_en: I have not thought about online counselling, I have been focused on trying to find somewhere else to live. I will look online.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I would suggest apne routine ko follow karo, motivated raho aur new place ke liye keep looking. Kabhi kabhi partner ke sath baithkar conversation karne se bhi help mil sakti hai.
dialog.content_en: I would suggest follow your routine, stay motivated and keep looking to for the new place. Sometime sitting with the partner and having conversation with the person might help.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I do not understand ki mera partner kyun chahta hai ki main leave karun. It came suddenly one day about 2 months ago.
dialog.content_en: I do not understand why my partner wants me to leave. I came suddenly one day about 2 months ago.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: The whole break up shayad drug addiction se related hai. I know ki mujhe problem hai.
dialog.content_en: The whole break up probably has to do with drug addiction. I know that I have a problem.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Have you ever tried yeh habit quit karne ki ya pehle counselling li hai?
dialog.content_en: Have you ever tried to quit this habit or had counselling before?

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Shayad yahi reason ho. Isko quit karna impossible nahi hai. You just need thodi si guidance.
